text:
maria: Heads up — seeing a lot of flapping on the blackbox streaming probes for eu-west1 inference endpoints this morning. Alerts fired ~3:20UTC and then cleared, repeated ~3:28 and ~3:35. Seems correlated with short-lived network stepping in the region.
joel: I saw that too. Grafana shows spikes in handshake latency for websocket probes, ~300-700ms bursts. No capacity alerts on GPUs tho. suspect network-level churn not pod CPU.
carly: Which probe job is this? the streaming check or the generic http-success probe? we have separate rules.
maria: streaming-checks-euw and embeddings-http-euw. streaming-checks has `probe_timeout: 2s` and `interval: 15s`. could be too aggressive for transient routing blips.
dan: can you paste the alert rule? we might be flapping because `for: 1m` + interval 15s leads to frequent transitions.
maria: alert snippet from prometheus-alerts:

```
- alert: BlackboxStreamingProbeFailed
  expr: sum by(job) (increase(blackbox_probe_success{job="streaming-checks-euw"}[5m])) < 1
  for: 1m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "eu-west1 streaming probe failure"
```

maria: Also probe logs show `io: read/write timeout` followed by `connection reset by peer` in the same minute.
joel: My take: two things — increase the `for:` window to 5m for paging, add a degraded alert for 1m, and increase probe timeout to 5s for streaming websocket handshake. reduces noisy pages and still catches real outages.
carly: agree. propose three-tier alerting:
- info (degraded): success_rate < 99% over 10m -> slack notify
- warning (service-impact): success_rate < 95% over 5m -> oncall notify
- page (outage): success_rate < 50% over 5m -> page

joel: Also add a streaming-specific metric: `blackbox_stream_handshake_latency_seconds_bucket` so we can alert on P95 > 200ms.
dan: good call. we should also correlate with route53 health checks and VPC flow logs before paging infra.
infra-bot: quick note — eu-west1 had a network policy rollout at 03:18UTC affecting a subset of leaf switches. rollback completed at 03:30UTC. Related SIG logs: `bgp-session-flap` on 10.2.3.0/24 for 12s.
maria: thanks infra-bot — that matches the 3:20 and 3:28 events. so noise source is infra change. still want probe tuning so users are not paged for routine infra rollouts.
probe-bot: recommended probe config diff (dry-run):

```
job_name: streaming-checks-euw
metrics_path: /probe
params:
  module: [websocket_handshake]
probe_timeout: 5s
interval: 30s
```

probe-bot: also add label `region=euw` to make alert scoping easier.
joel: Prometheus alert rule I'd push:

```
- alert: BlackboxStreaming_Degraded
  expr: (1 - sum(rate(blackbox_probe_success{job="streaming-checks-euw"}[10m])) / sum(rate(blackbox_probe_total{job="streaming-checks-euw"}[10m]))) > 0.01
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: info
```

- and a paging rule replacing the old one:

```
- alert: BlackboxStreaming_Outage
  expr: sum by(job) (increase(blackbox_probe_success{job="streaming-checks-euw"}[5m])) == 0
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
```

carly: pls also update the Grafana SLO panel to surface `p95_connected_latency` and add an annotation for infra change windows (we can pipe infra-bot events to grafana annotations).
maria: Runbook steps for oncall when BlackboxStreaming_Outage fires:
1) check grafana -> `Streaming / eu-west1 / p95 handshake latency` panel
2) `kubectl get pods -n monitoring -l app=blackbox-exporter` to ensure probe pods healthy
3) `curl -v --header 'Upgrade: websocket' https://<endpoint>/ws` from monitoring jump box
4) check vpc flow logs and infra-bot recent events
5) if BGP flap confirmed, page infra-network oncall
6) if probe pods unhealthy, restart: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/blackbox-exporter -n monitoring`

maria: I'll update the alert rules and create a PR to change probe interval to 30s + timeout 5s, and add the degraded alert.
joel: I can add the grafana panel changes and an annotation pipeline. will also add a small playbook snippet in runbooks/streaming-probes.md
carly: one cost note — doubling interval from 15s to 30s halves probe traffic egress for eu-west. thumbs up on that for non-prod jobs.
dan: assign to maria for alerts + pr, joel for dashboards, me to coordinate with infra on a longer-term mitigation (staged network policy rollouts w/ health gating).
maria: on it — PR will include tests and a dry-run for alert evaluation. ETA ~ 2h.
joel: thanks. please tag #oncall when you flip the rules so we can watch noise.
infra-bot: scheduled follow-up — network team will add a health-gate to next rollout to avoid bgp-session flaps.
maria: sounds good. will post post-mortem if paging occurs. :thumbsup:
